title: Traveler brings home a newly-evolved 'hybrid' mpox virus - Earth.com
snippet: A new form of the mpox virus has surfaced in England, detected in a traveler returning from Asia and carrying a hybrid strain that blends genetic material from two different mpox lineages. Clade Ib belongs to a clade, a genetic branch within the mpox virus family, that has recently appeared outside African hotspots. Recombination can occur when a person is infected with two mpox clades at once, allowing the viruses to swap pieces of DNA. Genomic testing in England showed that the traveler carried a hybrid mpox virus made from clade I and clade II strains. The case highlights how global travel and circulation of mpox clades give the virus more chances to recombine and produce new variants. Confirming that an infection belongs to clade Ib requires genomic sequencing, reading the virus genetic code so scientists can group related cases. The spread of clade Ib and the appearance of a hybrid virus in a traveler suggest that mpox is adapting to humans.
